definitions.explanation: getting chilled or catching a cold after bathing, typically from not drying off or dressing properly

examples.japanese: {湯冷|ゆざ}め⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧。
examples.english: Be careful not to catch cold after your bath.

examples.japanese: ⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乾|かわ}かさない→乾かす：01931_kawakasu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{湯冷|ゆざ}め⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: If you don't dry your hair, you'll catch cold.

examples.japanese: ⟦{風呂上|ふろあ}がり→風呂上がり：22451_furoagari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{薄着|うすぎ}→薄着：14028_usugi⟧で⟦いたら→いる：00495_iru⟧{湯冷|ゆざ}め⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I caught a cold because I was lightly dressed after my bath.

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
⟦{湯|ゆ}→湯：01740_yu⟧ (hot water, bath) + ⟦{冷|さ}め→冷める：02114_sameru⟧ (getting cold)

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, bathing culture emphasizes warming up fully in the bath. {湯冷|ゆざ}め is a common concern, especially:
- In winter months
- For children and elderly
- After ⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧ or ⟦{銭湯|せんとう}→銭湯：16032_sentou⟧

PREVENTION:
- ⟦{髪|かみ}を{乾|かわ}かす→髪を乾かす：23573_kamiwokawakasu⟧ - dry your hair
- ⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{拭|ふ}く→拭く：04261_fuku⟧ - dry body thoroughly
- ⟦{暖|あたた}かい→暖かい：00618_atatakai⟧⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧ - wear warm clothes
